title: Coupling Markov chains with a common image chain
summary: Consider time-homogeneous discrete-time Markov chains $X$, $Y$, and $Z$ on countable state spaces, considered as stochastic processes with specified initial distributions. Suppose for maps $f$ and $g$ that $(f(X_t))_{t \ge 0}$ and $(g(Y_t))_{t \ge 0}$ are both equal in law to $Z$. We prove that $X$ and $Y$ can be coupled so that $(X_t, Y_t)_{t \ge 0}$ is a homogeneous Markov chain with $f(X_t) = g(Y_t)$ for all $t \ge 0$.
